test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-5) Official Paper (Held On: 15 June 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Kuldiep Singh took additional charge of which post in May 2021?

options.text: Director General of the National Investigation Agency

solution:
The correct answer is __**Director General of the National Investigation Agency.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• CRPF Chief Kuldiep Singh has been given the additional charge of the Director General of the National Investigation Agency (NIA) to replace Y C Modi.
 
• **Modi was a 1984-batch IPS officer** of the Assam-Meghalaya cadre.
 
• He was appointed as the chief of the federal anti-terror probe agency in September 2017.
 
• Consequent to the superannuation of Y C Modi, DG, NIA, **on May 31, 2021**, the competent authority has **approved that Kuldiep Singh shall hold additional charge of the post of DG, NIA.**
 
• He should hold the charge till the appointment and joining of the successor or until further orders.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Currently, Dinkar Gupta serves as the Director-General of the National Investigation Agency since 28 June 2022.**
 
• The NIA (National Investigation Agency) can investigate terror cases across the country without having to get permission from the states.
 
• The agency investigates terror offenses, waging war against the country, offenses on nuclear facilities, etc.
 
• It came into force after Parliament passed the National Investigation Agency Act 2008.
